name: typesense-sync
comment: firebase-admin is NOT imported by this function — it is firebase-functions' peer, used internally to build the DocumentSnapshot handed to the trigger. It must satisfy firebase-functions@7's peer range (^11.10 || ^12 || ^13); the repo root pins ^10.0.2, which yarn tolerates locally but the Cloud Functions builder (npm) rejects with ERESOLVE. These versions are resolved at deploy time and are independent of the workspace's.
